description: Dynamics training dataset collected from a trained EfficientZero benchmark on Atari. Contains latent states, actions, ground-truth next states, and benchmark dynamics predictions for offline dynamics network development.

fields.frames: [T, H, W, C] uint8 - raw observation frame at each step
fields.dynamics_projections: [T, D] float32 - projection of G(s_t, a_t)
fields.valid_next: [T] bool - True if next_latent_state is a real next state

notes.stacking: Latent states are computed from 4 stacked frames. At step t, stacked_obs = [frame_{t-3}, ..., frame_t]. At episode start (t < 4), earlier positions are filled with copies of the initial frame.
notes.normalization: Frames are stored as uint8 [0-255]. The representation network expects float32 inputs normalized by dividing by 255.
notes.valid_next: valid_next[t]=False at the last step of an episode or at terminal states. next_latent_states[t] is meaningless when valid_next[t]=False.
